lines.en: HEY! IT’S US AGAIN! AND WE’RE NEVER GOING AWAY!

BUT THE GREAT NEWS IS THAT RAID: SHADOW LEGENDS IS NOW ROCKET MONEY: SHADOW LEGENDS! AND WITH THE HELP OF SPIRIT HALLOWEEN, HOLIDAY INN, COCA-COLA, AND NORD VPN, WE’RE GOING TO PUT THE FIRST EVER ARBY’S ON THE FUCKING MOON!!! HOLY SHIT!!!!
(This message has been sponsored by OperaGX)
: And we’re back! After a much shorter commercial this time since advertising slots are getting way more pricey now that the Dorm Wars is a nationally beloved event.
: Hi, Mom! Hi, Dad! I get to a be a judge again! And for an event much more suited to my tastes than the one swimsuit contest that got really weird really quickly a while back.
: Sorry, is this one not weird yet? Because Nodoka’s kind of only wearing a bra and I’m worried about what this is going to do to our ratings.
: Probably increase ‘em, not gonna lie.
: How about you take your shirt off as well, Makoto? Exhibitionism is socially acceptable so long as you can conceal it under the guise of exercise.
: Exhibitionism? You mean like an...exhibition match?
: If that answer brings you closer to removing your shirt as well, then yes. That is precisely what I meant.
: Gonna stop you right there, Nodoka. Karin’s the last remaining member of the “do not corrupt” list and I don’t want you seducing her no matter how socially acceptable it may currently be.
: S...Seduce?! That’s not what’s happening here, is it?! It’s totally normal to wear an outfit like Nodoka’s while exercising! I just...don’t do that myself because of...reasons.
: Yes, and we’re all very envious of your “reasons.” But Nodoka’s not the type to be trusted in basically any situation ever and I’m sure she just wants to show off right now.
: Show off what, exactly? My body isn’t nearly as impressive as any of yours. I’m just dressing the part, is all.
: See?! Totally normal. She just likes exhibitionism.
: Never change, Karin. Like, really. I don’t want to see what you become.
: So, like...what is the goal here, exactly? Is this any different from the contest Miku and Kirin took place in several years ago? Or-
: I’m glad you asked, Makoto! Because if we stalled any longer, we might not even make it to our second televised contest of the day! Why don’t you go ahead and tell ‘em, Karin?
: R-Right! So, as I’m sure you’ve already heard, this will be a full-body fitness competition. And each of you will be judged based on three categories: stamina, agility, and strength.
: Full body, you say? But I’ve yet to do any of my stretches. You wouldn’t mind helping me out, would you, Karin?
: Of course I can! That’s-
: Nope! That’d be grounds for disqualification.
: But stretching before rigorous exercise is important. And I help her all the time in the locker room at swim club.
: Oh. So that’s what those noises are.
: Nodoka.
: What can I say? I’m a very tense girl. And I require a great deal of both attention and assistance.
: She really is. Even the slightest touch normally makes her-
: Three stages! Stamina! Agility! Strength! Whoever wins two out of three rounds will be crowned the winner!
: And, in the event that neither of these two weaklings are able to finish any of the competitions, the win will go to whoever finishes one round!
: Or just...whoever did the best if you two can’t finish any of Karin’s tests. She’ll just choose a winner if that’s the case, I guess.
: So Sensei’s just not involved in any capacity and this will be an entirely unbiased competition based on skill and merit rather than who he likes the most?
: Right.
: Shit.
: Is something the matter, Makoto? You don’t believe yourself to be inferior to me physically as well, do you?
: I’m not sure, to be honest. I imagine most other girls would have just died after what Yumi did to you in the classroom. So I believe there’s a good chance you could be hiding something here.
: You’re more than welcome to strip search me if you’re that worried.
: Something mental. I have no interest in seeing you naked.
: Aww, not even a little? I guess we’re not as similar as I thought then. How sad.
: Can we just start this thing already? I’d rather just lose than stand here while this psychopath pretends to hit on me.
: Bitch, no you wouldn’t. You hate losing more than anybody I know.
: Kiss me and I’ll let you win. How about that?
: No! It’s not winning if you let me do it! And I’m one of the few girls in our class who isn’t gay!
: N-Nodoka’s gay?!
: I’m just Nodoka. You can use whatever word for me you’d like.
: Then how about “loser?” Let’s do this.
: Playing hard to get will only make me love you more.
: Contestants! On your marks!
: Wait, our marks?! Where are our marks?! Which test are we even doing first?!
: Oh! S-Sorry! We’ll be testing your stamina first so we can see how it affects the rest of the competition for you. The first one to make it through five laps of the track wins.
: F-Five?! The track is like half a kilometer!
: Why, yes! It is. And you can line up right over there.
: Ugh...There as in...here? Is this good?
: Mhm! And Nodoka can-
: Ah!
: Karin, you need to stop touching her!
: S-She wasn’t moving on her own! Is...Is it because she’s gay? Should I not-
: No, I will!
: Aaah! Please...there’s enough me to go around...
: I’m startin’ to feel like I should’ve just taught middle school instead.
: Contestants! On your marks...
: Get set...
: Wait one second. Miku! Cover your ears!
: Thank you, Karin! Done!
: Then...
: Ngh!
: Have fun, Makoto! Until we meet again~
: She runs kind of funny...
: Like a dung beetle but without its ball of excrement.

: Now, I know it’s not my place to say this, but I think you should probably be, um...participating in this contest, Nodoka. At the very least, for Makoto’s sanity. It’s true that a win isn’t a win if it’s just handed over.
: Yes, I suppose you’re right. The issue here is that participating right now would involve me running. And, to be honest, I’m not sure if I even know how to do that.
: So...this is a calculated move and you’re intentionally abstaining so that Makoto tires herself out prior to the next two rounds?
: No. She will likely beat me in those as well. I have no desire to move this body in ways that does not extract pleasure directly from another human being.
: I wish I had a net...
: Oh. Hello again, Futaba. Do you like my outfit? I wore it for you.
: Nodoka? Why aren’t you competing? I thought your desire to win Sensei would outweigh your desire to never move your body in ways that do not directly extract pleasure from another human being.
: Which isn’t her telling you to actually compete, by the way. I think this strategy is great. And I’m definitely not just saying that because I want to win either.
: You misunderstand, ladies. There’s no way I’d ever win this round even if I gave it my all.
: I don’t really know how true that is when Makoto’s barely even moved since the gun went off.
: It’s a stamina contest, not a speed one. And let’s be honest here, she’s likely been run through by Akira so many times that she could go ten laps without needing to catch her breath.
: That’ll be me one day, I hope.
: Rin, come on.
: What? You guys have been doing it forever and I haven’t even gotten a chance to yet. I want to increase my stamina too, you know.
: Why...can’t I...move...any further?!
: You know, I often think I’d be much better off if my last school never sunk into the ground.
: Hey. How’s the contest going? I was talking to Io and missed the beginning part of it.
: This is the beginning part of it.
: And potentially the ending too since I’m not sure I’ve ever seen two people this out of shape before. Ain’t all you youths supposed to be full of energy and whatnot?
: It seems like less being out of shape and more just...not being accustomed to physical exertion.
: Oh, Makoto’s accustomed to physical exertion alright.
: Meaning what exactly, Kirin?
: Uhh...n...nothing! That...sounded wrong.
: Do you mean...because she’s in the swim club, maybe?
: Y-Yes! That is exactly what I meant.
: Why not mention Nodoka too then? She’s in the club. And a much better swimmer than Makoto.
: Yeah, Nodoka’s actually great at swimming. That’s why I’m so surprised to see her not even trying. It might just be a strategy thing, though.
: Guess I just need to...brush up on my swim team knowledge then! Hahah...
: I...I’m gonna go find Miku or something.
: Contest two is the cone dodge! Move through all the cones as quickly as you can without getting hit. Whoever comes out of the cone maze first wins the round!
: Wh...Where did you even get all these traffic cones? Did you rob the public works department or something?
: They’re used for soccer, I believe. I used to gaze longingly out of the window after school in hopes of being one day crushed between the thighs of the entire team.
: Like, one after the other? Or all at once?
: I see no reason why it can’t be both. Also, Makoto-
: Wait, hold on. Why are you so good at this? You’re not doing, like...equations in your head to calculate movement or something, are you?
: It’s just physics. And calculating such things is no different than counting stairs as you descend them. Also, Makoto-

: It’s totally different! Stop calculating things and just use your body! Beating me in this round after practically quitting in the first one is going to fry my brain and make it harder for me to concentrate!
: I think it already may have since you overlooked some rather crucial wording about this contest just a moment ago.
: What?! What are you talking about?!
: Dodge the cones without getting hit. You don’t find that phrasing odd?
: She obviously just meant that we don’t want to bump into the cones! Not everything is rocket science, Nodo-
: MAKOTO! LOOK OUT!
: For what?! I’m trying to-
: Guh!
: See, this is exactly why you need to be paying attention.
: FUCK YOU AND FUCK WHOEVER THREW THAT CONE!!!!
: Can I sit on your lap?
: No.
: Please?
: No.
: Please?
: Ami, no. We’re in public.
: Please?
: Ami-
: Please?
: Hah...fine. But only for a-
: Yay! And I only had to ask once.
: Mhm. Right.
: Hi. I’ve done some thinking over the last hour or so and, upon further reflection, I can not, in good faith, compete against this girl.
: Then just do it in bad faith.

: I can try. I’m really bad at bad faith, though. Like, even when I fuck with Maya, I have to spend at least thirty minutes decompressing and telling myself I’m not a bad person afterward. It really sucks.
: Girl.
: I’m also starting to get offended that Chika’s just totally fine around me if this is her reaction to meeting Nee-chan.
: Girl?...
: Yes, Chika. Girl.
: Also, what’s Ami doing in your lap? That’s where I want to be. Where do I sign up? Is there a line? Because I’ll wait.
: No line. I’m just exercising my God-given right to sit on my dad’s lap in public. He has a boner right now.
: No, Ami. I do not.
: He has a boner and he’s thinking about putting it inside of me while all of you are forced to watch.
: Really, though. Where do I get in line?
: Aww, come on! Again?!
: And so it all comes down to this! A test of strength between who I can only imagine are the two weakest girls in all of Kumon-mi!
: Tell me — how’s this contest measuring up to your expectations so far, Karin?
: Poorly! But it seems like both girls are giving it their all, which is really the most important part when it comes to exercise.
: Any guesses on who’s going to take round three now that our game is tied at one to one?
: That’s a great question, Miss Imai. But maybe we should see what they have to say for themselves instead?
: I am going to destroy you.
: I concur. I will soon be destroyed.
: Okay, never mind. I think Makoto is going to win.
: Mngh!
: Is something wrong, Makoto? Why haven’t you defeated me yet?
: I’m...trying! But you’re...fighting back!
: Is that not what you wanted?
: I...do! Just...s...
: Stop...resisting!...
: There’s a joke to be made here but I really don’t want to be the one to make it.
: You know, the kiss offer is still on the table.
: You think I will...take that bait just because I...hate losing?!

: Kind of, yeah. And honestly, I’m only bringing it up because I accidentally won the last round and am able to hold out in this one due to the arm strength that tirelessly writing has bestowed unto me.
: You are...so lucky I...tired myself out!
: Am I? Now, should I interpret that as you considering my offer? Or am I lucky because you haven’t wiped the floor with me?
: Because, need I remind you, I wanted that to happen. And I’m actually quite disappointed that it hasn’t yet.
: Then just...take the fall, damn it! I don’t even care that it...wouldn’t be a real win anymore!
: Oooh...that just gives me a chance to sweeten the pot then, doesn’t it?
: You...wouldn’t...dare!
: Let’s speak privately later. I don’t think my new idea is one that should be televised.
: I’m...not...a lesbian!
: And you don’t have to be. Do you understand?
: No! But fuck it! I want to win and if making some sort of shady deal is the price I must pay, so be it!
: Oh, Makoto. You really do suck at losing, don’t you?
: Yes! I do! And we all know I do, so what’s the point in hiding it anymore?!
: We have a deal then?
: Fine! Yes! Whatever!
: Excellent. Come find me later tonight then. I have some...questions for you.
: F...Fine! Just...f...fucking...mngh!
: I’m not even resisting anymore. Are you truly this weak?
: DIEEEEEEEEEEE!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
: Well, ladies and gentlemen! It was definitely a contest! And every contest must have its winner!

: Unless that contest ends in a tie! Which, sometimes, it does! But that’s normally for more informal contests. Which...I guess the Dorm Wars would actually be since the Dorm Wars itself can end in a tie!

: But if this new rule about Miss Imai being the winner in the event of a tie is real, doesn’t that mean it wouldn’t really be a tie at all and make this entire tangent kind of unrelated? Maybe! I don’t know!
: But there isn’t a tie today because today’s winner is Makoto Miyamura! Which brings the score of the sixth annual Dorm Wars to 1-0 in favor of the first floor!
: Do you have any words for the fans back home, Makoto? Or maybe your mom, who I’ve heard loves you very much?
: No.
: None at all? Not even a little one? Like a...thank you? Or something like that?
: No.
: Will you at least tell your mom you love her in the event that she’s watching back at home?
: No!
: Makoto. Tell your mom you love her right this instant or I’ll take your point away.
: Y...You can’t do that! Surely, that’s against the rules!
: Maybe. But so is buying a win and I turned the other cheek to that! Now tell your mom you love her or Nodoka wins instead!
: Mmngh...
: Now...
: I love you, Mom.
: Yay! That concludes our first competition!
: Join us after another word from our sponsors to find out who comes out on top of Kaori Kadowaki’s Chaotic Cooking Class Competition! See you next time!
